title: Clear stale output on parse failure

context.hint: Make failure outputs deterministic in a recovery parser and verify successful parsing at input boundaries.
context.surface: A C recovery helper parses a bounded list and returns a presence flag through an output parameter.
assumptions: Use synthetic inputs and a local parser harness.

review.invariant: Every rejected input leaves the presence flag false when an output parameter is provided.
review.verification: Prefill the output flag with true, submit malformed data and assert that parsing fails and clears the flag. Verify valid inputs still report their expected presence state.

source_observation.summary: The baseline retained the caller-supplied true flag on failure. The repaired boundary test passed, including under sanitizers. The existing application caller initialized the flag to false, so the finding concerns the helper contract.
